name: Practiced Bomber
body:
You have continued to improve your explosives knowledge while pursuing other lines of inquiry.

Prerequisite(s): Bomb class feature.

Benefit(s): The damage and saving throws of your bombs are calculated as though your alchemist level were 4 levels higher, to a maximum effective alchemist level equal to your character level.

Special: You can select this feat multiple times. Its effects stack.
